participants.role_in_journey: Initiates FX spot trade enquiry, reviews firm quote, accepts or rejects within 30-second validity window, receives trade confirmation via SWIFT MT300 and portal notification

interactions.action: Submits FX trade enquiry — currency pair, notional, direction, value date
interactions.channel: CH-008 (treasury portal) or telephone to PER-053
interactions.outcome: Receives indicative rate with disclaimer (not a firm price)

interactions.action: Reviews firm quote on treasury portal — sees firm_rate, spread, valid_until countdown
interactions.outcome: 30-second countdown starts; decision point: accept or let quote expire

interactions.action: Confirms acceptance of firm quote (clicks 'Accept Trade' or verbal confirmation on recorded line)
interactions.outcome: Trade booked; trade reference number returned
Confirmation document received; right to dispute within confirmation window

participants.role_in_journey: Retrieves interbank rates via Bloomberg FXGO, generates firm quotes with approved mark-up, executes trades on behalf of clients (phone-dealt), monitors settlement on value_date, handles exception paths (rate feed failure, sanctions holds)
regulatory_obligations: FCA SM&CR Certified Function — dealing in investments as principal
COBS 11.2A — call recording mandatory for voice-dealt FX transactions
MiFIR best execution obligation — must document interbank reference rate and spread at time of quote

interactions.action: Retrieves indicative rate via SVC-007 API; relays to PER-003
May override spread within delegated authority for relationship pricing; confirms quote parameters
interactions.outcome: Firm quote generated with valid_until = now + 30s

interactions.action: For phone-dealt trades: captures client verbal acceptance on recorded line; enters trade in system
interactions.outcome: Trade booked; call_recording_ref stored on FXTrade

interactions.action: Monitors settlement exceptions; resolves insufficient balance or sanctions hold with Treasury Operations

participants.role_in_journey: Primary orchestrating service for JRN-014. Creates and manages FXTrade (ENT-040), FXQuote (ENT-041), FXSettlement (ENT-042). Enforces 30-second quote validity. Gates settlement on sanctions clearance. Triggers MiFIR transaction reporting.

Called synchronously by SVC-007 (same-capability) for: BusinessCustomer status validation at enquiry; sell-currency account balance check before execution; account debit (sell leg) and credit (buy leg) at settlement.

Consumes EVT-089 (FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened) — cross-capability async event. Screens the counterparty against OFSI, OFAC, UN, and HM Treasury sanctions lists. Publishes result; if hit detected, SVC-007 receives notification and blocks FXSettlement.
participants.communication_pattern: Cross-capability async only — event-driven via SVC-102

participants.role_in_journey: Consumes EVT-086 (FXTradeConfirmed) to transmit SWIFT MT300 confirmation. Consumes EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) to execute nostro-to-nostro settlement on value_date. Publishes EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) back to SVC-007.
participants.communication_pattern: Cross-capability async only — event-driven via SVC-102

participants.role_in_journey: Routes all cross-capability events: EVT-089 (CAP-002 → CAP-005), EVT-086/EVT-087 (CAP-002 → CAP-003), EVT-088 (CAP-003 → CAP-002).
Delivers portal and email notifications to PER-003 at key lifecycle events: quote provided (PH-060), trade confirmed (PH-062), settlement completed (PH-063).
